headline: Wendt (India) Limited: Capital infusion in wholly owned subsidiary
sum: Wendt (India) Limited announced capital infusion into a wholly owned subsidiary, disclosed via NSE intimation on 23 June 2026.
implication: Capital infusion into a wholly owned subsidiary may trigger related-party transaction disclosure and subsidiary consolidation review under accounting standards; verify whether Ind-AS 27 or Schedule III (Companies Act) disclosure obligations apply.
detail: Wendt (India) Limited, a listed entity on NSE, informed the exchange of a capital infusion into its wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction was disclosed via formal NSE intimation. No transaction value, specific subsidiary name, or investment structure was disclosed in the primary notice. The nature and extent of the capital infusion remain to be confirmed from subsidiary financial statements or board minutes filed with the Registrar of Companies.
